key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on denying salt and fire to others?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from Imam Ali (peace be upon him), recorded in Al-Kafi, establishes the principle that essential natural resources like salt and fire are public goods (mubahat) that cannot be exclusively monopolized or withheld. It serves as a foundational legal precedent in Shia jurisprudence for the right of access to basic necessities, emphasizing that while ownership may exist, the utility of these fundamental elements remains accessible to all.
